```{r Analysis for Hake}

str(hake)
colnames(hake)

# Delete's 2026 data
hake <- subset(hake, year != 2026)


# columns with most NA's
colSums(is.na(hake))
na_counts <- colSums(is.na(hake))
sort(na_counts, decreasing = TRUE) #dlr_stid, ves_len, dlr_cflic, lon_dd, lat_dd, docid, record_sail/land, market/grade_desc-- signifcant NA values.


# Most common state and port
sort(table(hake$state), decreasing = TRUE) #RI, MA, NY, NH, NJ, CT have the largest counts.
sort(table(hake$port), decreasing = TRUE)

#By Category

#All categories per year #separated by market category

year_table <- table(hake$year, hake$market_desc)
print(year_table)


ggplot(as.data.frame.table(year_table), aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2)) +

#Unclassified per year

ggplot(stack(unclassified_per_year), aes(x = ind, y = values)) +
  geom_col(fill = "purple", color = "black") +

  theme_minimal() +

#Landings (lb) by year

  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +

# Monthly Landings
```

# GEAR

```{r Hake Gear}

#Gear from code(github) to naming the function
apply_gear_categories <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    mygear = case_when(
      # LineHand
      negear %in% c(10, 20, 21, 22, 30, 34, 40, 60, 62, 65, 66, 90, 250, 251, 330, 340, 380, 410, 414, 420) ~ "LineHand",
      negear >= 220 & negear <= 230 ~ "LineHand",
      
      # Seine -> Misc
      negear %in% c(70, 71, 160, 360) ~ "Misc",
      negear >= 120 & negear <= 124 ~ "Misc",
      
      # Trawl
      negear >= 50 & negear <= 59 ~ "Trawl",
      negear %in% c(150, 170, 350, 351, 353, 370, 450) ~ "Trawl",
      
      # Gillnet
      negear >= 100 & negear <= 117 ~ "Gillnet",
      negear %in% c(500, 520) ~ "Gillnet",
      
      # PotTrap
      negear >= 180 & negear <= 217 ~ "PotTrap",
      negear >= 300 & negear <= 301 ~ "PotTrap",
      negear %in% c(80, 140, 141, 142, 143, 240, 260, 270, 320, 321, 322, 323) ~ "PotTrap",
      
      # Dredge + Unknown -> Misc
      negear >= 381 & negear <= 383 ~ "Misc",
      negear %in% c(132, 400) ~ "Misc",
      negear == 999 ~ "Misc",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
}

hake_updated <- apply_gear_categories(hake)

sort(table(hake_updated$mygear), decreasing = TRUE) # Mostly done with Trawl and Gillnet. Small portion was done by Linehand, PotTrap, and Misc.

# Size
sort(table(hake_updated$mesh_cat), decreasing = TRUE) #Mesh size was mostly small and Large. Very few with XL.


#price by gear
price_gear <- hake_updated %>%
  group_by(mygear) %>%
  summarize(median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE))

print(price_gear)


# Comparison between gear vs total landings

gear_market_table <- table(hake_updated$mygear, hake_updated$market_desc)

ggplot(as.data.frame.table(gear_market_table), aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Hake Market Categories by Gear Type", x = "Gear Type", y = "Percentage", fill = "Market Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


```

```{r bsb_vessel_explorations.R for Hake}
# =============================================================================
# Script:  bsb_vessel_explorations.R
# Purpose: Stacked bar charts of BSB landings by hullid and by permit,
#          showing the top-25 vessels by all-time total for each state
#          and coastwide. Excludes placeholder/unknown hullids.
# Inputs:  data_folder/main/commercial/landings_all_{in_string}.Rds
# Outputs: images/exploratory/hullid_{state}.png    (one per state)
#          images/exploratory/permit_{state}.png     (one per state)
#          images/exploratory/hullid_coastwide.png
#          images/exploratory/permit_coastwide.png
# Notes:   Ported from stata_code/analysis/bsb_vessel_explorations.do
#          in_string must be set before sourcing (via wrapper or manually).
#          Stata uses tsfill + reshape wide + graph bar for stacked bars;
#          R uses tidyr::complete() + ggplot2::geom_col(position="stack").
#          Top-25 selected by all-time vessel total (matching Stata bysort-tl logic).
# =============================================================================


# Placeholder hullids to exclude (Stata: multiple drop if inlist(hullid, ...))
bad_hullids <- c(
  "PA9999", "NY0000", "MD9999", "NJ9999", "NC9999", "NH9999", "MS9999",
  "VA9999", "NY9999", "CTD9999", "RI9999",
  "000", "0000", "00000", "000000", "0000000", "00000000",
  "999999", "Unknown", "UNREGISTER", "FROM_SHORE"
)

atlantic_states <- c("CT", "DE", "MA", "MD", "NC", "NJ", "NY", "RI", "VA")


# =============================================================================
# Load and prepare
# =============================================================================

landings_raw <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("hake_landings_all_2026-06-08.Rds"))
)

landings <- landings_raw %>%
  filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>%
  mutate(dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date)) %>%
  # Collapse to permit-hullid-state-year and convert to 000s lbs
  group_by(year, state, permit, hullid) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lndlb = lndlb / 1000) %>%
  # Keep Atlantic states; drop vessel size class placeholders and pure-state records
  filter(
    state %in% atlantic_states,
    !permit %in% c("190998", "290998", "390998", "490998"),
    !(hullid %in% c("0000000", "000000") & permit == "000000"),
    hullid != "FROM_SHORE"
  )


# =============================================================================
# Helper: select top-25 vessels by all-time total, fill zeros for missing years
# Mirrors Stata: encode; tsset; tsfill, full; bysort id: egen tl=total(lndlb);
#                bysort year (tl): gen r=_N-_n+1; keep if r<=25
# =============================================================================

top25_by_id <- function(df, id_col) {
  id_sym <- sym(id_col)

  df %>%
    # complete() = tsfill, full: fill all id × year combos with lndlb = 0
    complete(!!id_sym, year, fill = list(lndlb = 0)) %>%
    # all-time total per id (bysort id: egen tl=total(lndlb))
    group_by(!!id_sym) %>%
    mutate(tl = sum(lndlb)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # rank within each year by all-time total, descending (r=1 = largest)
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(r = rank(-tl, ties.method = "first")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(r <= 25) %>%
    select(-tl, -r)
}

# =============================================================================
# Helper: stacked bar chart of landings by vessel id
# =============================================================================

stacked_bar <- function(df, id_col, title_str) {
  n_ids <- n_distinct(df[[id_col]])
  pal   <- unname(pals::polychrome(max(n_ids, 2)))  # polychrome min is 2
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(year), y = lndlb, fill = .data[[id_col]])) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(
      x     = "Year",
      y     = "Landings (000s lbs)",
      title = title_str
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# Per-state plots: hullid and permit
# Stata: levelsof state; foreach st { preserve; keep if state=="`st'"; ... }
# =============================================================================

walk(sort(unique(landings$state)), function(st) {

  # --- Hullid stacked bar ---
  hull_data <- landings %>%
    filter(state == st) %>%
    group_by(hullid, year) %>%
    summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!hullid %in% bad_hullids) %>%
    top25_by_id("hullid")

  p_hull <- stacked_bar(hull_data, "hullid",
                        glue("{st} landings by hullid (top 25)"))
  ggsave(file.path(img_dir, glue("hullid_{st}.png")),
         plot = p_hull, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message(glue("Saved: hullid_{st}.png"))

  # --- Permit stacked bar ---
  permit_data <- landings %>%
    filter(state == st) %>%
    group_by(permit, year) %>%
    summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(permit != "000000") %>%   # Stata: drop if inlist(permit,0)
    top25_by_id("permit")

  p_permit <- stacked_bar(permit_data, "permit",
                          glue("{st} landings by permit (top 25)"))
  ggsave(file.path(img_dir, glue("permit_{st}.png")),
         plot = p_permit, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message(glue("Saved: permit_{st}.png"))
})

# =============================================================================
# Coastwide plots
# =============================================================================

# Coastwide hullid
hull_cw <- landings %>%
  group_by(hullid, year) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!hullid %in% bad_hullids) %>%
  top25_by_id("hullid")

p_hull_cw <- stacked_bar(hull_cw, "hullid", "Top 25 landings by hullid — coastwide")
ggsave(file.path(img_dir, "hullid_coastwide.png"),
       plot = p_hull_cw, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: hullid_coastwide.png")

# Coastwide permit
permit_cw <- landings %>%
  group_by(permit, year) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(permit != "000000") %>%
  top25_by_id("permit")

p_permit_cw <- stacked_bar(permit_cw, "permit", "Top 25 landings by permit — coastwide")
ggsave(file.path(img_dir, "permit_coastwide.png"),
       plot = p_permit_cw, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: permit_coastwide.png")



```

```{r}

apply_market_rebinning_dealers <- function(df) {
  df %>% dplyr::mutate(
    market_desc = dplyr::if_else(market_desc == "MIXED OR UNSIZED", "UNCLASSIFIED", market_desc),
    market_code = dplyr::if_else(market_code == "MX", "UN", market_code),
    market_desc = dplyr::if_else(market_desc == "MEDIUM OR SELECT", "MEDIUM", market_desc),
    market_desc = dplyr::if_else(market_desc == "PEE WEE (RATS)", "EXTRA SMALL", market_desc),
    market_code = dplyr::if_else(market_code == "PW", "ES", market_code)
  )
}
```



```{r hake_exploratory_dealers}

# =============================================================================
# Section 1: Load, clean, merge gears, apply dealers market rebinning. I did this before exploring vessel analysis.
# =============================================================================

landings_raw <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("hake_landings_all_2026-06-08.Rds"))
)
cams_gears <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("cams_gears_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)

dealers_annual <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("dealers_annual_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)



colnames(landings_raw)
colnames(cams_gears)



landings <- landings_raw %>% 
  dplyr::filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>% # Fixed the filter conflict error here
  mutate( 
    dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date), 
    dateq = paste0(lubridate::year(dlr_date), "Q", lubridate::quarter(dlr_date)) 
  ) %>% 
  left_join(cams_gears, by = "negear") %>% 
  apply_gear_categories() %>% # Custom function loaded from source()
  apply_market_rebinning_dealers() %>% # Custom function loaded from source()
  mutate( 
    mym = factor(market_desc, levels = c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL", "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED")) 
  )



# =============================================================================
# Section 2: Collapse to dealer × year × market category; merge dealer names
# Stata: collapse (sum) lndlb, by(dlrid year market_desc)
#        merge m:1 dnum year using dealers_annual
# =============================================================================

dealer_mkt <- landings %>%
  group_by(dlrid, year, mym) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

dealer_mkt<-dealer_mkt %>%
  mutate(dlrid=as.numeric(dlrid))

# Stata: rename dlrid dnum; merge; rename dnum dlrid
dealer_mkt <- dealer_mkt %>%
  left_join(dealers_annual %>% rename(dlrid = dnum), by = c("dlrid", "year"))

# dealers_annual has some 'gaps' in it, sometimes a dealer has a permit in year 1 and 3, but not year 3. 
# this causes the dealer's demographics to be missing, including dlr_name 

# Pivot wide: one lndlb column per market category (reshape wide lndlb, j(mym))
dealer_wide <- dealer_mkt %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = mym,
    values_from = lndlb,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Stata: foreach var of varlist lndlb*: replace var=0 if var==.
# (pivot_wider values_fill handles this)

# Stata: egen total=rowtotal(lndlb1-lndlb6)
dealer_wide <- dealer_wide %>%
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(
      select(., any_of(c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL",
                         "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED"))),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    unclassified_frac = if_else(total > 0, UNCLASSIFIED / total, NA_real_)
  )

# Yearly totals for comparison
yearly_unc <- dealer_wide %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    t6 = sum(UNCLASSIFIED, na.rm = TRUE),
    tt = sum(total,        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(yearly_unc = t6 / tt)

dealer_wide <- dealer_wide %>%
  left_join(yearly_unc %>% select(year, yearly_unc), by = "year")

# Stata: gen f6 = lndlb6/t6 (share of total yearly unclassified from this dealer)
dealer_wide <- dealer_wide %>%
  left_join(yearly_unc %>% select(year, t6), by = "year") %>%
  mutate(f6 = if_else(t6 > 0, UNCLASSIFIED / t6, NA_real_))

# Rank dealers by share of unclassified (frank: highest f6 = rank 1)
dealer_ranked <- dealer_wide %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(frank = rank(-f6, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Stata: browse if year>=2010 & frank<=5  → print top dealers by unclassified share
cat("\n=== Top 5 dealers by share of yearly unclassified landings (2010+) ===\n")
print(
  dealer_ranked %>%
    filter(year >= 2010, frank <= 5) %>%
    arrange(year, frank) %>%
    select(year, dlrid, any_of(c("dlr_name")), yearly_unc, unclassified_frac,
           UNCLASSIFIED, f6, t6, frank)
)

# Stata: browse if unclassified_frac > yearly_unc & year>=2010
cat("\n=== Dealers with above-average unclassified fraction (2010+) ===\n")
print(
  dealer_wide %>%
    filter(year >= 2010, unclassified_frac > yearly_unc) %>%
    arrange(year, desc(unclassified_frac)) %>%
    select(year, dlrid, any_of(c("dlr_name")), yearly_unc, unclassified_frac)
)


# =============================================================================
# Section 3: Simpler analysis — unclassified landings by status and market code
# (Second use of landings_all in the Stata script)
# =============================================================================

landings1.5 <- landings_raw %>%
  filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>%
  mutate(
    dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date),
    dateq    = paste0(lubridate::year(dlr_date), "Q", lubridate::quarter(dlr_date)),
    # Simpler market rebinning used in second section of the Stata script
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "MIXED OR UNSIZED", "UNCLASSIFIED", market_desc),
    market_code = if_else(market_code == "MX", "UN", market_code),
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "MEDIUM OR SELECT", "MEDIUM", market_desc),
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "PEE WEE (RATS)", "EXTRA SMALL", market_desc),
    market_code = if_else(market_code == "PW", "ES", market_code),
    mym = factor(market_desc,
                 levels = c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL",
                            "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED"))
  )

# Stata: collapse (sum) lndlb, by(year mym status)
unclass_by_status <- landings1.5 %>%
  group_by(year, mym, status) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Stata: browse if mym==6 (UNCLASSIFIED)
cat("\n=== Unclassified landings by year and status ===\n")
print(
  unclass_by_status %>%
    filter(as.character(mym) == "UNCLASSIFIED") %>%
    arrange(year, status)
)
```

```{r vessel_explorations for Tile}


# =============================================================================
# Script:  bsb_vessel_explorations.R
# Purpose: Stacked bar charts of BSB landings by hullid and by permit,
#          showing the top-25 vessels by all-time total for each state
#          and coastwide. Excludes placeholder/unknown hullids.
# Inputs:  data_folder/main/commercial/landings_all_{in_string}.Rds
# Outputs: images/exploratory/hullid_{state}.png    (one per state)
#          images/exploratory/permit_{state}.png     (one per state)
#          images/exploratory/hullid_coastwide.png
#          images/exploratory/permit_coastwide.png
# Notes:   Ported from stata_code/analysis/bsb_vessel_explorations.do
#          in_string must be set before sourcing (via wrapper or manually).
#          Stata uses tsfill + reshape wide + graph bar for stacked bars;
#          R uses tidyr::complete() + ggplot2::geom_col(position="stack").
#          Top-25 selected by all-time vessel total (matching Stata bysort-tl logic).
# =============================================================================


# Placeholder hullids to exclude (Stata: multiple drop if inlist(hullid, ...))
bad_hullids2 <- c(
  "PA9999", "NY0000", "MD9999", "NJ9999", "NC9999", "NH9999", "MS9999",
  "VA9999", "NY9999", "CTD9999", "RI9999",
  "000", "0000", "00000", "000000", "0000000", "00000000",
  "999999", "Unknown", "UNREGISTER", "FROM_SHORE"
)

atlantic_states2 <- c("CT", "DE", "MA", "MD", "NC", "NJ", "NY", "RI", "VA")


# =============================================================================
# Load and prepare
# =============================================================================

landings_raw2 <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("tile_landings_all_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

landings2 <- landings_raw2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>% 
  mutate(dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date)) %>%
  # Collapse to permit-hullid-state-year and convert to 000s lbs
  group_by(year, state, permit, hullid) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lndlb = lndlb / 1000) %>%
  # Keep Atlantic states; drop vessel size class placeholders and pure-state records
  filter(
    state %in% atlantic_states,
    !permit %in% c("190998", "290998", "390998", "490998"),
    !(hullid %in% c("0000000", "000000") & permit == "000000"),
    hullid != "FROM_SHORE"
  )


# =============================================================================
# Helper: select top-25 vessels by all-time total, fill zeros for missing years
# Mirrors Stata: encode; tsset; tsfill, full; bysort id: egen tl=total(lndlb);
#                bysort year (tl): gen r=_N-_n+1; keep if r<=25
# =============================================================================

top25_by_id <- function(df, id_col) {
  id_sym <- sym(id_col)

  df %>%
    # complete() = tsfill, full: fill all id × year combos with lndlb = 0
    complete(!!id_sym, year, fill = list(lndlb = 0)) %>%
    # all-time total per id (bysort id: egen tl=total(lndlb))
    group_by(!!id_sym) %>%
    mutate(tl = sum(lndlb)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # rank within each year by all-time total, descending (r=1 = largest)
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(r = rank(-tl, ties.method = "first")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(r <= 25) %>%
    select(-tl, -r)
}


# =============================================================================
# Helper: stacked bar chart of landings by vessel id
# =============================================================================

stacked_bar <- function(df, id_col, title_str) {
  n_ids <- n_distinct(df[[id_col]])
  pal   <- unname(pals::polychrome(max(n_ids, 2)))  # polychrome min is 2
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(year), y = lndlb, fill = .data[[id_col]])) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(
      x     = "Year",
      y     = "Landings (000s lbs)",
      title = title_str
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# Per-state plots: hullid and permit
# Stata: levelsof state; foreach st { preserve; keep if state=="`st'"; ... }
# =============================================================================

walk(sort(unique(landings2$state)), function(st) {

  # --- Hullid stacked bar ---
  hull_data <- landings2 %>%
    filter(state == st) %>%
    group_by(hullid, year) %>%
    summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!hullid %in% bad_hullids) %>%
    top25_by_id("hullid")

  p_hull <- stacked_bar(hull_data, "hullid",
                        glue("{st} landings by hullid (top 25)"))
  ggsave(file.path(img_dir, glue("hullid_{st}.png")),
         plot = p_hull, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message(glue("Saved: hullid_{st}.png"))

  # --- Permit stacked bar ---
  permit_data <- landings2 %>%
    filter(state == st) %>%
    group_by(permit, year) %>%
    summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(permit != "000000") %>%   # Stata: drop if inlist(permit,0)
    top25_by_id("permit")

  p_permit <- stacked_bar(permit_data, "permit",
                          glue("{st} landings by permit (top 25)"))
  ggsave(file.path(img_dir, glue("permit_{st}.png")),
         plot = p_permit, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
  message(glue("Saved: permit_{st}.png"))
})

# =============================================================================
# Coastwide plots
# =============================================================================

# Coastwide hullid
hull_cw <- landings2 %>%
  group_by(hullid, year) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!hullid %in% bad_hullids) %>%
  top25_by_id("hullid")

p_hull_cw <- stacked_bar(hull_cw, "hullid", "Top 25 landings by hullid — coastwide")
ggsave(file.path(img_dir, "hullid_coastwide.png"),
       plot = p_hull_cw, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: hullid_coastwide.png")

# Coastwide permit
permit_cw <- landings2 %>%
  group_by(permit, year) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(permit != "000000") %>%
  top25_by_id("permit")

p_permit_cw <- stacked_bar(permit_cw, "permit", "Top 25 landings by permit — coastwide")
ggsave(file.path(img_dir, "permit_coastwide.png"),
       plot = p_permit_cw, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: permit_coastwide.png")



```

```{r publication_quality_plots, fig.width=16, fig.height=22, dev='png', dpi=300}
# Custom publication with  crisp small text
theme_pub <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) + # Smaller, crisp academic font size
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans", color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"), # Clean box for headers
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"), # Forces massive space between sub-plots
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 12))
    )
}
```

```{r}
  group_by(dlrid, year, market_desc ) %>%
  summarise(transactions=n(),
            value=sum(value, na.rm=TRUE),

            sd_price=sd(price, na.rm=TRUE),
```

```{r Exploration on 2006 data}
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_transactions = n(), 
    total_lbs_landed = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE),
    overall_avg_price = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2005, 2006, 2007)) %>% 
  print()

#Which market category is driving 2006 up?

cat("\n--- AVERAGE PRICE BY MARKET CODE (Is one category driving the spike?) ---\n")
top_3_ma %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2005, 2006, 2007)) %>% 
  group_by(year, market_desc) %>% 
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(year, desc(avg_price)) %>% 
  print()

#one specific Hull ID driving the spike?

cat("\n--- AVERAGE PRICE BY HULL ID (Is one boat skewing the year?) ---\n")
top_3_ma %>% 
  dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2005, 2006, 2007)) %>% 
  group_by(year, hullid) %>% 
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  print()
```

```{r exploratory dealers for tilefish}
#exploratory dataset
colnames(landings_raw2)
colnames(cams_gears)
# Load, clean, merge gears, apply dealers market rebinning


landings_raw2 <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("tile_landings_all_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)
cams_gears <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("cams_gears_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)

dealers_annual <- readRDS(
  here("data_folder", "main", "commercial", glue("dealers_annual_2026-06-09.Rds"))
)


landings2 <- landings_raw2 %>%
  filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>%
  mutate(
    dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date),
    dateq = paste0(lubridate::year(dlr_date), "Q", lubridate::quarter(dlr_date))
  ) %>%
  left_join(cams_gears, by = "negear") %>% 
  apply_gear_categories() %>%
  apply_market_rebinning_dealers() %>%
  mutate(
    mym = factor(market_desc, levels = c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL", "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED"))
  )


# Section 2: Collapse to dealer × year × market category; merge dealer names, collapse (sum) lndlb, by(dlrid year market_desc)


dealer_mkt2 <- landings2 %>%
  group_by(dlrid, year, mym) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

dealer_mkt2<-dealer_mkt2 %>%
  mutate(dlrid=as.numeric(dlrid))

# Stata: rename dlrid dnum; merge; rename dnum dlrid
dealer_mkt2 <- dealer_mkt2 %>%
  left_join(dealers_annual %>% rename(dlrid = dnum), by = c("dlrid", "year"))

# dealers_annual has some 'gaps' in it, sometimes a dealer has a permit in year 1 and 3, but not year 3. 
# this causes the dealer's demographics to be missing, including dlr_name 

# Pivot wide: one lndlb column per market category (reshape wide lndlb, j(mym))
dealer_wide2 <- dealer_mkt2 %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = mym,
    values_from = lndlb,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Stata: foreach var of varlist lndlb*: replace var=0 if var==.
# (pivot_wider values_fill handles this)

# Stata: egen total=rowtotal(lndlb1-lndlb6)
dealer_wide2 <- dealer_wide2 %>%
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(
      select(., any_of(c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL",
                         "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED"))),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    unclassified_frac = if_else(total > 0, UNCLASSIFIED / total, NA_real_)
  )

# Yearly totals for comparison
yearly_unc2 <- dealer_wide2 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    t6 = sum(UNCLASSIFIED, na.rm = TRUE),
    tt = sum(total,        na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(yearly_unc = t6 / tt)

dealer_wide2 <- dealer_wide2 %>%
  left_join(yearly_unc %>% select(year, yearly_unc), by = "year")

# Stata: gen f6 = lndlb6/t6 (share of total yearly unclassified from this dealer)
dealer_wide2 <- dealer_wide2 %>%
  left_join(yearly_unc %>% select(year, t6), by = "year") %>%
  mutate(f6 = if_else(t6 > 0, UNCLASSIFIED / t6, NA_real_))

# Rank dealers by share of unclassified (frank: highest f6 = rank 1)
dealer_ranked2 <- dealer_wide2 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(frank = rank(-f6, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  ungroup()

# St browse if year>=2010 & frank<=5  → print top dealers by unclassified share
cat("\n=== Top 5 dealers by share of yearly unclassified landings (2010+) ===\n")
print(
  dealer_ranked2 %>%
    filter(year >= 2010, frank <= 5) %>%
    arrange(year, frank) %>%
    select(year, dlrid, any_of(c("dlr_name")), yearly_unc, unclassified_frac,
           UNCLASSIFIED, f6, t6, frank)
)

# browse if unclassified_frac > yearly_unc & year>=2010
cat("\n=== Dealers with above-average unclassified fraction (2010+) ===\n")
print(
  dealer_wide2 %>%
    filter(year >= 2010, unclassified_frac > yearly_unc) %>%
    arrange(year, desc(unclassified_frac)) %>%
    select(year, dlrid, any_of(c("dlr_name")), yearly_unc, unclassified_frac)
)

#  unclassified landings by status and market code

# Second section near the bottom of your chunk
landings2 <- landings_raw2 %>%
  filter(merge_species_codes != 1) %>%
  mutate(
    dlr_date = as.Date(dlr_date),
    dateq = paste0(lubridate::year(dlr_date), "Q", lubridate::quarter(dlr_date)),
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "MIXED OR UNSIZED", "UNCLASSIFIED", market_desc),
    market_code = if_else(market_code == "MX", "UN", market_code),
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "MEDIUM OR SELECT", "MEDIUM", market_desc),
    market_desc = if_else(market_desc == "PEE WEE (RATS)", "EXTRA SMALL", market_desc),
    market_code = if_else(market_code == "PW", "ES", market_code),
    mym = factor(market_desc, levels = c("JUMBO", "LARGE", "MEDIUM", "SMALL", "EXTRA SMALL", "UNCLASSIFIED"))
  )


# Stata: collapse (sum) lndlb, by(year mym status)
unclass_by_status2 <- landings2 %>%
  group_by(year, mym, status) %>%
  summarise(lndlb = sum(lndlb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Stata: browse if mym==6 (UNCLASSIFIED)
cat("\n=== Unclassified landings by year and status ===\n")
print(
  unclass_by_status %>%
    filter(as.character(mym) == "UNCLASSIFIED") %>%
    arrange(year, status)
)
```
